Verification (proof lines 3013-3028): given epsilon_0 with the relation, define epsilon_n = epsilon_0 U(alpha) for any alpha: [0] -> [n]; if beta is another choice, both alpha and beta factor through some gamma: [1] -> [n], and the relation on epsilon_0 shows epsilon_n is well defined; the simplicial-morphism identity epsilon_n U(varphi) = epsilon_m is then the same definition applied to alpha composed with varphi.

The morphism identity is the same definition reapplied to the composite vertex.
